//: tsx config for the headless agent harness. The `@/*` paths let a Node script import the real DNA lib graph from apps/web; the single explicit override ahead of it swaps the browser supabase client (createBrowserClient + cookies + window diagnostics) for a Node one. Order matters — the specific mapping must precede the wildcard.
//include: Entry scripts live in scripts/, not scripts/harness/. Without this, tsc's default (**/* relative to THIS file) covered only the harness modules — the drivers, grader, suite and pairwise were never typechecked at all, which is how a duplicate top-level declaration reached runtime past a green check.
